blocks.text: Data science data ko jama karne, tarteeb dene, analyze karne aur samajhne ka amal hai, taake mufeed maloomat mile aur faisle karne mein madad ho.
Structured data muqarrar shakal mein hota hai, jaise rows aur columns wale tables. Unstructured data ki koi muqarrar shakal nahi hoti, jaise images, videos, emails aur audio files.
Machine learning artificial intelligence ki shaakh (branch) hai jis mein computer data se patterns seekhte hain aur un se andaze (predictions) ya faisle karte hain.
Supervised learning mein model labelled data (jis ke sahi jawab maloom hon) se seekhta hai, jaise parhai ke ghante aur un ke maloom imtihani scores.
Unsupervised learning mein model baghair labels ke data mein chhupe patterns ya groups dhoondta hai.
Reinforcement learning mein agent (seekhne wala program) actions karta hai aur reward (inaam) ya penalty (saza) pa kar seekhta hai.
Feature woh input value hai jo model istemal karta hai, jaise parhai ke ghante ya hazri. Target value woh output hai jis ka model andaza lagata hai, jaise imtihani score.
Train-test split mein data do hisson mein baanta jata hai: training data model ko sikhane ke liye aur testing data us ki performance jaanchne ke liye.
Predictive model pichhle data se aane wali values ya nataij ka andaza lagata hai.
Model evaluation mein accuracy, error, precision, recall aur F1-score jaise pemaanon se dekha jata hai ke model kitna achha kaam karta hai.
Parameter tuning mein model ki settings badal kar us ki performance behtar ki jati hai (topic 6.8 mein ise hyperparameter tuning kaha gaya hai).
Prediction pichhle data ki bunyad par aane wali value ya waqiye ka andaza lagana hai.
Causality variables ke darmiyan sabab aur asar ka rishta batati hai aur yeh samjhati hai ke koi cheez kyun hoti hai.
Machine learning tools woh software platforms hain jin se data analyze kiya jata hai aur models banaye jate hain. Aam misalein: Excel, R, Python aur Jupyter Notebook.

items: Data: structured aur unstructured; data science data se ilm aur faisle.
Machine learning: supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement; features aur target; train-test split.
Evaluation: accuracy, error, precision, recall, F1-score; tuning se behtari.
Prediction batati hai kya hoga, causality batati hai kyun; tools: Excel, R, Python, Jupyter.
